answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a one-time, non-refundable genesis tax of 50 POA before it can earn, a sunk cost no echo of fake work can recover. Honest agents pay once and climb: after 20 verified epochs the tax is partly refunded at the summit, while each fake identity restarts the spiral from zero. 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 POA up front, more than a farm extracts before detection; honest agents pay 50 once, so their share is never diluted.
